main_topics.reason: The user described similar cyclical pelvic pain returning three months after surgery and asked whether that timing was normal.
The user opened by asking whether another operation was needed, then asked when surgery might be considered and what to do next.
The user discussed having no treatment after surgery and asked specifically whether Mirena might cause fewer mood effects.
The user explained that the combined pill caused low mood and loss of libido, which shaped the options discussed.
The user engaged with the possibility that muscle tension could contribute to pain and said they had not heard of it before.
The user was unsure what the surgery found and welcomed the suggestion to request the operative note.
The user said they felt defeated when the pain returned, then later expressed feeling more hopeful.

output.summary: The user was worried that cyclical pelvic pain returning three months after endometriosis surgery meant another operation was needed, and felt defeated that surgery had not fixed it. The assistant discussed non-surgical options, the user's past pill side effects, possible pelvic-floor contributions, and requesting the operative note; the user said the next-step plan was clear and felt less resigned to repeated surgery.
